calibration.fitted_on: the same-subject validation split, so the rejection threshold is tuned on an easier distribution than a new user presents

test_protocol: subject-disjoint: trained on participants P1-P8, tested on P9-P10, who appear in no training image. test_accuracy is that number. same_subject_accuracy is a random split over the training participants and is reported only to show how much such a split flatters the model.
